content: 第二关（后）

speaker: Amiya
content: They've lost all humanity...

speaker: Rhodes Island Operator
content: Amiya...

speaker: Amiya
content: Yeah. I'm fine.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Can we still reach Blaze, Doctor, and GreyThroat?
speaker: Amiya
content: Can we still reach Blaze, Doctor, and GreyThroat?

speaker: Rhodes Island Operator
content: No problem.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Good. Keep in touch with them. Help them find their way.
speaker: Amiya
content: Good. Keep in touch with them. Help them find their way.

speaker: Herd
content: (Thirsty howling).

raw: [name="Amiya"]  I can't feel... anything from you anymore. That faint outline of a thread of hatred, it all came from Mephisto...
speaker: Amiya
content: I can't feel... anything from you anymore. That faint outline of a thread of hatred, it all came from Mephisto...

raw: [name="Amiya"]  I have to cleanse it... the poison of Mephisto's hate.
speaker: Amiya
content: I have to cleanse it... the poison of Mephisto's hate.

speaker: Amiya
content: I promise. I will.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I've finished mopping up the Reunion stragglers and reached the waypoint. But we've found the situation in the slums is not what we expected.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I've finished mopping up the Reunion stragglers and reached the waypoint. But we've found the situation in the slums is not what we expected.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  The L. G. D. unit guarding the area found no traces of Reunion. I'm going to have to investigate myself.
speaker: Ch'en
content: The L. G. D. unit guarding the area found no traces of Reunion. I'm going to have to investigate myself.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  There's been a reduction in the Infected mutants? Is that your doing?
speaker: Ch'en
content: There's been a reduction in the Infected mutants? Is that your doing?

speaker: Ch'en
content: No?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Stay frosty... You never know what danger might be hiding in the shadows.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Stay frosty... You never know what danger might be hiding in the shadows.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Don't let your guard down. These Infected are a lot more to handle than your run-of-the-mill Reunion.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Don't let your guard down. These Infected are a lot more to handle than your run-of-the-mill Reunion.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Once I finish my work here, I'll send a team to assist you. Keep the channel open. Over and out.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Once I finish my work here, I'll send a team to assist you. Keep the channel open. Over and out.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Who's there?!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  It's me! Reporting in!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: It's me! Reporting in!

speaker: Ch'en
content: Not you...

speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Huh...?

speaker: Ch'en
content: Nothing. Report in.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Yes, Sir! As ordered, we swept the area!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Yes, Sir! As ordered, we swept the area!

speaker: Ch'en
content: What did you find?

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Nothing! Not a single Reunion footprint to be found!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Nothing! Not a single Reunion footprint to be found!

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I told you to be on the lookout for anything unusual!
speaker: Ch'en
content: I told you to be on the lookout for anything unusual!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Oh... Oops. We really don't know this area at all.
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Oh... Oops. We really don't know this area at all.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  I mean, according to procedure, we don't come in here until there's a problem so serious we have to tear down a block or something.
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: I mean, according to procedure, we don't come in here until there's a problem so serious we have to tear down a block or something.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I know... The slums don't exist to you, as long as they're quiet.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I know... The slums don't exist to you, as long as they're quiet.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  When we cut off Reunion, there was a deafening sound coming from this place, and half the residents here vanished.
speaker: Ch'en
content: When we cut off Reunion, there was a deafening sound coming from this place, and half the residents here vanished.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Look at the toys scattered around our feet... Look at this and tell me there's nothing out of the ordinary.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Look at the toys scattered around our feet... Look at this and tell me there's nothing out of the ordinary.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Was there anything in the plan about evacuating all the residents of the slums?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Was there anything in the plan about evacuating all the residents of the slums?

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  ...There are a few things out of the ordinary. Most of the buildings in the district have been abandoned or otherwise ruined.
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: ...There are a few things out of the ordinary. Most of the buildings in the district have been abandoned or otherwise ruined.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  The streets that are still here are completely empty. Presumably a result of crossfire between Reunion and the locals.
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: The streets that are still here are completely empty. Presumably a result of crossfire between Reunion and the locals.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  And there have been a few fires. We have extinguished them. They seem to have been caused by household functions such as heating and cooking.
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: And there have been a few fires. We have extinguished them. They seem to have been caused by household functions such as heating and cooking.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  All buildings show signs of forced entry, but there is no trace of any resistance from the residents.
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: All buildings show signs of forced entry, but there is no trace of any resistance from the residents.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  As for Reunion, there's really no sign of them at all. Just... some cleaning residue.
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: As for Reunion, there's really no sign of them at all. Just... some cleaning residue.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Do you care nothing for the civilians here?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Do you care nothing for the civilians here?

speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: ...Sorry, Sir!

speaker: Ch'en
content: What are you apologizing for?

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  I don't know, Sir!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: I don't know, Sir!

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Whatever... Why should you care about anyone in a place like this?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Whatever... Why should you care about anyone in a place like this?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Hurry up and send out some teams to lock down the area!
speaker: Ch'en
content: Hurry up and send out some teams to lock down the area!

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  No one gets in or out. No vehicles either. Reunion or otherwise!
speaker: Ch'en
content: No one gets in or out. No vehicles either. Reunion or otherwise!

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  As for you... You come with me. We're going north.
speaker: Ch'en
content: As for you... You come with me. We're going north.

speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Yes, Sir!

speaker: Ch'en
content: (Shh. Don't make a sound!)

speaker: Ch'en
content: (This way. Quickly.)
Very perceptive.

speaker: Ch'en
content: What are you doing?!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Preparing to fire!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Preparing to fire!
You should not follow.
Control your subordinates, Ch'en.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Go find Swire.

speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: But, Sir...

speaker: Ch'en
content: Go!

speaker: Ch'en
content: Who sent you?

raw: [name="???"]  I do not answer to you.
content: I do not answer to you.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  You think you can run? Try and I'll arrest you on the spot.
speaker: Ch'en
content: You think you can run? Try and I'll arrest you on the spot.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  You're an unidentified armed element of unknown origin. How do you think the L. G. D. is going to treat you? We might just shoot you dead.
speaker: Ch'en
content: You're an unidentified armed element of unknown origin. How do you think the L. G. D. is going to treat you? We might just shoot you dead.

raw: [name="???"]  Training a new L. G. D. unit would be a waste of Lungmen's time, treasure, and talent.
content: Training a new L. G. D. unit would be a waste of Lungmen's time, treasure, and talent.

raw: [name="???"]  And eradicating the entire L. G. D. would be a crushing blow to the heart of the Lungmen community. You should not take the risk.
content: And eradicating the entire L. G. D. would be a crushing blow to the heart of the Lungmen community. You should not take the risk.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Hah! Is that threat supposed to scare me? Or should I be thanking you for your concern over Lungmen's future?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Hah! Is that threat supposed to scare me? Or should I be thanking you for your concern over Lungmen's future?

raw: [name="???"]  Ch'en, the L. G. D. is the face of Lungmen, as well as a pillar of her community, and an exemplary show of her strength.
content: Ch'en, the L. G. D. is the face of Lungmen, as well as a pillar of her community, and an exemplary show of her strength.

raw: [name="???"]  And the L. G. D. should stay in its lane.
content: And the L. G. D. should stay in its lane.

raw: [name="???"]  Don't let it stick its nose where it doesn't belong.
content: Don't let it stick its nose where it doesn't belong.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Your threats are really not impressing me. Hurry up and answer the question: where did all the locals go?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Your threats are really not impressing me. Hurry up and answer the question: where did all the locals go?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  You're one tap of this 'alert all units' button away from making an enemy out of the entire L. G. D.
speaker: Ch'en
content: You're one tap of this 'alert all units' button away from making an enemy out of the entire L. G. D.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Or I guess you could take a split second to knock away my sword, slice off my arm, and snatch away this transceiver.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Or I guess you could take a split second to knock away my sword, slice off my arm, and snatch away this transceiver.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Where did all the slum dwellers go?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Where did all the slum dwellers go?

raw: [name="???"]  We will withdraw from this place. Ch'en, you and I both withdraw. For now, let us not interfere with one another.
content: We will withdraw from this place. Ch'en, you and I both withdraw. For now, let us not interfere with one another.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  And where is it you think you're going?
speaker: Ch'en
content: And where is it you think you're going?

raw: [name="???"]  These new-type Infected Reunion is controlling may well interfere with our carefully laid plans.
content: These new-type Infected Reunion is controlling may well interfere with our carefully laid plans.

raw: [name="???"]  We will swiftly remove them for the L. G. D., please do your part to exterminate Reunion's main force.
content: We will swiftly remove them for the L. G. D., please do your part to exterminate Reunion's main force.

raw: [name="???"]  If the L. G. D. seeks to actualize its strategic goals, it should focus on its own duties. You must do that which you must do.
content: If the L. G. D. seeks to actualize its strategic goals, it should focus on its own duties. You must do that which you must do.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Wait! You think you can just leave?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Wait! You think you can just leave?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Come and go as you please?!
speaker: Ch'en
content: Come and go as you please?!

raw: [name="???"]  Superintendent Ch'en, let me give you a suggestion.
content: Superintendent Ch'en, let me give you a suggestion.

raw: [name="???"]  Do not seek to investigate what has happened here. I look to Lord Wei, and will banter with you no longer.
content: Do not seek to investigate what has happened here. I look to Lord Wei, and will banter with you no longer.

raw: [name="???"]  By the way, cutting off your arm is quite simple. When you stand resolute, you are a hundred times stronger than now.
content: By the way, cutting off your arm is quite simple. When you stand resolute, you are a hundred times stronger than now.

speaker: Swire
content: Hey——!

speaker: Ch'en
content: Stay back, Swire!

speaker: Ch'en
content: Get back here!
I will see myself out.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Damn it!

raw: [name="Swire"]  What was that all about? Who was that?
speaker: Swire
content: What was that all about? Who was that?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Lungmen's special forces are on the move. And I don't know if the people of this district are piled in a mass grave somewhere.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Lungmen's special forces are on the move. And I don't know if the people of this district are piled in a mass grave somewhere.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Huh? What are you talking about...?
speaker: Swire
content: Huh? What are you talking about...?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Don't play dumb. You know. Or at least you've heard.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Don't play dumb. You know. Or at least you've heard.

speaker: Swire
content: Know what...?

speaker: Swire
content: Wait, do you know?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I don't know. But your grandfather definitely knows.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I don't know. But your grandfather definitely knows.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Huh? Seriously, what are we even talking about? Diu ah! Just come out with it already!
speaker: Swire
content: Huh? Seriously, what are we even talking about? Diu ah! Just come out with it already!

raw: [name="Swire"]  My grandpa's totally bedridden. I can't get two words out of him!
speaker: Swire
content: My grandpa's totally bedridden. I can't get two words out of him!

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Being sick in bed means he can't run Lungmen anymore? You know better than I what kind of man your grandfather is!
speaker: Ch'en
content: Being sick in bed means he can't run Lungmen anymore? You know better than I what kind of man your grandfather is!

speaker: Swire
content: No way!

speaker: Ch'en
content: Who are you thinking?

speaker: Swire
content: 'Lin Gray.'

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Hmph. Now I'm the one who gets to say 'no way!' Lin runs the slums as his personal fief. There's no way he'd let something like this happen.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Hmph. Now I'm the one who gets to say 'no way!' Lin runs the slums as his personal fief. There's no way he'd let something like this happen.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Make a few phone calls and ask around. Maybe you'll find out.
speaker: Swire
content: Make a few phone calls and ask around. Maybe you'll find out.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Are you calling? Or should I?
speaker: Swire
content: Are you calling? Or should I?
